verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਜੁਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣਿਆ ਇਕਸ ਪਿਛੈ ਸਭ ਦੇਸੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: satijug paap kamaaniaa ikas pichhai sabh dhes dhukhaalaa|

en.bdb: In satyug, the whole country suffered due to the evil deeds of even one individual.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੇਤੈ ਨਗਰੀ ਪੀੜੀਐ ਦੁਆਪੁਰਿ ਪਾਪੁ ਵੰਸੁ ਕੋ ਦਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: tretai nagaree peeReeaai dhuaapur paap va(n)s ko dhaalaa|

en.bdb: In tretayug, the evil committed by one, made the whole city suffer and in dvapar the whole family underwent the pains.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਬੀਜੈ ਸੋ ਲੁਣੈ ਵਰਤੈ ਧਰਮ ਨਿਆਉ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: kalijug beejai so lunai varatai dharam niaau sukhaalaa|

en.bdb: Simple is the justice of kaliyug; here only he reaps who sows.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਲੈ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਤਿਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਲਿਜੁਗਿ ਸਫਲੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਤਤਕਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: falai kamaanaa tih jugee kalijug safal dharam tatakaalaa|

en.bdb: In other three yugs, the fruit of the action was earned and accumulated but in kaliyug, one gets the fruit of dharma immediately.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਣੈ ਲੇਪੁ ਹੈ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਧਰਮ ਸੁਫਲੁ ਫਲਵਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: paap kamaanai lep hai chitavai dharam sufal falavaalaa|

en.bdb: Somethin* happens only after doing something in the kaliyug but even the thought of dharma gives the happy fruit in it.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਗੁਰਪੁਰਬ ਕਰਿ ਬੀਜਨਿ ਬੀਜੁ ਸਚੀ ਧਰਮਸਾਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: bhai bhagat gurapurab kar beejan beej sachee dharamasaalaa|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs, contemplating on the wisdom of Guru and the loving devotion, sow the seed in earth, the true abode of truth.
They succeed in their practice and objective.
